summary: Pilot Tyler Noel, 50, of Verona, Wisconsin and his wife Kristina, 49, crashed their Cirrus SR22T (N288WT) on an Aspen-to-Eagle County IFR flight after an airspeed-indication failure; Noel deployed the airframe parachute and the plane came down under canopy into steep, heavily wooded terrain near Lenado (~9,400 ft, Woody Creek area, ~5 mi north of Aspen); both uninjured and sheltering in the plane; 25 Mountain Rescue Aspen volunteers in 7 teams broke trail through waist-deep snow in the dark, located the wreck by its lights, and guided the couple out starting ~9:15 p.m. on a ~3-hour hike
location: near Lenado / Woody Creek area, ~5 miles north of Aspen (~9,400 ft)
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; Pitkin County Sheriff's Office
notes: NTSB prelim CEN20LA069 (accident 01/27/2020, 1524 MST, Woody Creek, CO; 2 none injured; CAPS deployed; flight ASE->EGE) + Aspen Times story rewrite, both via the Kathryn's Report page (parent-opened run 765). 2020-01-27 = Monday (weekday-verified; article says 'Monday afternoon/evening'). incident_type=vehicle per id 2271 (2014-02-14 Cirrus SR-22 crash, SAR rescue, survived) precedent. 2026-09-20: merged MRA FB post permalink (MRA's full mission narrative of the 2020-01-27 Woody Creek Cirrus SR22T crash (Tyler and K). 2026-09-20: merged MRA FB post permalink (MRA news-link share ('More to follow...') on the same 2020-01-27 Woody Creek plane crash; ).
